instructionalState.specification: All devbob containers in Kubernetes StatefulSet must have fully functional git operations (config, clone, commit, push, PR creation/merge)
instructionalState.context: Distributed DevBob deployment in local Kubernetes (docker-desktop, metabob namespace, 3 StatefulSet replicas)
instructionalState.requirement: Each devbob agent must independently manage vessel repository changes - critical for distributed autonomous development model where multiple devbob instances collaborate on code across repos

before.gitConfig: NOT present - user.name and user.email not configured
before.credentials: ABSENT - no GITHUB_TOKEN, GIT_USER_NAME, GIT_USER_EMAIL in environment
before.authentication: FAILED - gh auth status returns 'not logged in'
before.operations: BLOCKED - all git push operations fail with authentication errors

after.gitConfig: CONFIGURED - git config --global shows user.name, user.email, init.defaultBranch, push.autoSetupRemote
after.ghCli: INSTALLED - /usr/bin/gh available, version verified at container startup
after.credentials: PRESENT - GITHUB_TOKEN, GIT_USER_NAME, GIT_USER_EMAIL injected from Kubernetes secret
after.authentication: SUCCESS - gh auth status shows 'Logged in to github.com'
after.operations: ENABLED - clone, commit, push, PR create/merge all functional

functionalState.stateTransition: NOT functional → FULLY functional across all 3 pods
